title: Whole source context and reversible skull-base cutaway views
author: NeuroImage project
objective: Start with full categorical sections and source skull context, inspect chosen 3D half-spaces, and restore the whole source without generating anatomical boundaries.

scenes.title: Whole source context before a display cut
scenes.prompt: Observe the source skull and outer-table extents with sphenoidal sinus air, optic nerve and inner-ear context. Start from the complete sections, then magnify at the cursor. These are supplied material classes, not separately segmented skull-base bones.
scenes.note: Native MIDA categorical model sections and surfaces. The source Skull and skull outer-table classes retain their different delivered extents. Nerve and inner-ear classes retain the source combined-side definitions. The saved cutaway reveals existing source surfaces while complete 2D label sections remain available. Source structure identification and teaching interpretation have separate expert-review records.

scenes.title: Inspect below the native S = 0 mm display plane
scenes.prompt: Compare with the previous whole-context view. Only skull and cerebral tissue display fragments above S = 0 mm are hidden. The other source labels remain whole. Move the cut in Inspect, then return to this recorded view.
scenes.note: Native MIDA categorical model sections and surfaces. The source Skull and skull outer-table classes retain their different delivered extents. Nerve and inner-ear classes retain the source combined-side definitions. The saved cutaway reveals existing source surfaces while complete 2D label sections remain available. scenes.title: Sagittal cut through surrounding source context
scenes.prompt: Observe cochlear, semicircular-canal, mastoid-air and facial/vestibulocochlear source labels with surrounding context hidden where R > 0 mm. The plane is an explicit native-coordinate setting, not a verified mid-sagittal anatomical boundary. The nerve and inner-ear classes remain unsplit and uncut.
scenes.note: Native MIDA categorical model sections and surfaces. The source Skull and skull outer-table classes retain their different delivered extents. Nerve and inner-ear classes retain the source combined-side definitions. The saved cutaway reveals existing source surfaces while complete 2D label sections remain available. Source structure identification and teaching interpretation have separate expert-review records.

scenes.title: Restore whole source context after exploration
scenes.prompt: The same observation point and source labels are restored without a 3D cut. Compare with the preceding view and follow adjacent complete sections. Save or export your own scene explicitly when retaining a teaching adjustment.
